title: ProofSettings
description: What a project declares for proof, under settings in agentbay.config.yaml, by the name of the mode that implements proof@1. Every such mode reads these settings in this shape; its own settings schema is a copy of this file.

items.description: A path git ignores in the project, relative to the project's root.

links.description: The paths every throwaway copy gets as links to the project's own, for what its checks and tests need and a commit does not hold, such as a folder of installed packages; each must be ignored by git in the project. Left out, a copy gets no links.

items.description: One word given to the command.

bay.description: The words given to the copy's own ./bay.sh, run at the copy's root, such as check --project tests/fixtures/sound.

oneOf.description: A run of the copy's own ./bay.sh.

run.description: The name of one of the project's own commands, as the toolchain bound to toolchain@1 runs it in a copy with its action run: for TypeScript, a script of package.json, such as demo. Never a command line.

items.description: One word given to the command as one argument, exactly as written: no shell splits it or reads what it holds.

arguments.description: The words given to the command after its name, in this order; left out, none.

oneOf.description: A run of one of the project's own commands, by its name, through the toolchain.

items.description: One command whose output and exit code must not change unless a slice says so: the copy's own ./bay.sh with bay, or one of the project's own commands with run. One written with bay means what it meant before run was added.

sameOutput.description: The commands whose output must not change; left out, the project declares none and an item of the kind same-output is inconclusive.

name.description: The count's name, which an item of the kind count names in use.

pattern.description: The text a counted line holds, matched as it is written: a dot is a dot, not a pattern.

items.description: A file or folder relative to the repository's root; a folder counts every file under it.
One count that no slice may raise, such as the entries of a list of known breaks.

noRise.description: The counts that may not rise; left out, the project declares none.

declaredName.description: The command's name, which an item of the kind same-output names in differ.
